description: Schema guide for the Bangladesh HSC 12th Class Biology JSON question bank.

folder_structure.biology.json: Subject-level index containing paper and chapter metadata.
folder_structure.1st_Paper/chapter_XX.json: Chapter-wise MCQ data for Biology 1st Paper (Botany).
folder_structure.2nd_Paper/chapter_XX.json: Chapter-wise MCQ data for Biology 2nd Paper (Zoology).

chapter_file_fields.subject: String: subject name.
chapter_file_fields.total_mcqs: Integer: number of MCQs in chapter.
chapter_file_fields.total_topics: Integer: number of topics in chapter.

mcq_object.question: String: question text.
mcq_object.options: Array of four objects, each with label (A-D) and text.
mcq_object.explanation: String: explanation for the correct answer.
